d.title: Major Movie: Yuujou no Winning Shot
d.jp: 劇場版MAJOR 友情の一球（ウイニングショット）
d.synopsis: Goro briefly returns to Japan after a triumphant campaign in the US. He is heading towards Fukuoka where he played baseball when he was a fifth grader. Having just moved into a new town, this is where Goro faced a critical point in his life.
